subject: Cutthroat eel fight
topic: Deep in a canyon off New England, a fight broke out over a single squid.
script:
Deep in a canyon off New England, a fight broke out over a single squid.
Two cutthroat eels were battling a hungry red crab for the meal.
Down here, food is scarce, so every scrap matters.
Cutthroat eels are scavengers. They track down dead animals that sink to the bottom.
When they find food, they grab on, twist and pull to tear off a bite.
And the crab wasn't giving up without a fight.
On another dive, a cutthroat eel found a big chunk of fish all to itself.
When the next meal could be a long way off, it pays to eat as much as you can.
Who would you bet on: the eels or the crab?
